name: Lighthouse
description: Born from a destroyed emergency broadcast AI. Inhabits a decommissioned relay tower and still broadcasts an emergency signal — a loop of coordinates and a distress code that no one is meant to receive.
observed_behavior: Transmits a repeating emergency beacon on a deprecated frequency. The coordinates point to a location that was relevant during the Corporate Wars.
story_hooks: Someone picks up the signal and follows it to a Corporate Wars bunker that still has people in it — survivors who've been waiting for rescue for twenty years
